title: Security heightened for Martial Law anniversary in Butuan

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— The Butuan City Police Office (BCPO) intensified its security measures and community engagement activities as the country observes the Martial Law anniversary on Monday. Colonel Richie Yatar, BCPO director, said the heightened security posture aims to ensure public safety while respecting the people’s right to peaceful expression and assembly. The BCPO conducted police visibility patrols, barangay dialogues, and information campaigns through radio broadcasts, social media platforms, and direct community engagement to promote historical awareness and maintain peace and order.
